name: Priest of Fell Rites
oracle_text:
{T}, Pay 3 life, Sacrifice this creature: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
Unearth {3}{W}{B} ({3}{W}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step or if it would leave the battlefield. Unearth only as a sorcery.)
blocked_sentences: Unearth {3}{W}{B} ({3}{W}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step or if it would leave the battlefield. Unearth only as a sorcery.)

needs.what: a self-scoped, duration-bounded replacement of a permanent's *leave-the-battlefield* zone change -- "if this permanent would leave the battlefield, exile it instead" -- that fires for every destination (graveyard, hand, exile, library, command zone), not only for a death, and that is installed by the resolving unearth ability on the card it just returned and lasts as long as that permanent is on the battlefield
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `replace_deaths` is the only op in `ops` that redirects a zone change, and `zones.move_object` gates it on `from_zone is BATTLEFIELD and to_zone is GRAVEYARD` (src/automtg/engine/zones.py:95-99) -- so it catches a death and nothing else. Unearth's clause is the *whole* leave-the-battlefield event: bounced to hand, exiled by removal, shuffled into the library, sent to the command zone. Substituting `replace_deaths` is not a rounding error on this card, it is the card's central loop: this Priest's own ability sacrifices itself, and the printed replacement is what makes that a one-way trip. Modelled as death-only, an opponent's bounce or exile still leaves a card that can be unearthed again; modelled not at all (the engine's currently documented unearth divergence, docs/rules-coverage.md line 99, which pairs a `put_onto_battlefield` of `self_only` with `grant_keyword` haste and a `delay`ed `exile`), the sacrifice puts the Priest straight back in the graveyard to be unearthed again next turn, making it an unbounded reanimation engine the printed card explicitly forbids. `delay` cannot say it either: a delayed trigger fires at a named step, and this has to fire the moment the permanent would move, before it lands anywhere. `until_leaves` is the opposite link -- it declares a return, not an interception -- and `static_effects` carries only `replace_token_creation`, which docs/rules-coverage.md line 182 states is deliberately not the start of a general replacement system.
